title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Master Cylinder Push Rod May Disconnect (683 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Ram 1500 Classic SLT trucks.  Certain vehicles were built without the retaining clip that secures the master cylinder push rod to the brake pedal, which can cause the brake pedal to separate from the brake system.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Bolts May Be Missing From Front Seat Tracks (57 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2021 Volkswagen Tiguan Long Wheelbase and Jetta vehicles.  Bolts may be missing from the front seat tracks.

title: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc.: Electric Cabling Damaged (564 affected)
summary: Corp. Micro Bird, Inc. (Micro Bird) is recalling certain 2013-2021 Micro Bird G5 school buses with electrical wiring, routed behind the driver's seat, that may have been damaged during rivet installation.

title: Proterra Operating Company, Inc.: Front Fender Flare Improvement (21 affected)
summary: Proterra, Inc. (Proterra) is recalling certain 2020-2021 40' ZX5 vehicles.  These vehicles have a front fender flare which may cause mud, dirt, debris, rain and snow to splash onto the driver's side window and mirror.

title: Putco Inc: Bulb Exceeds Luminous Lux Standard/FMVSS 108 (31,716 affected)
summary: Putco Inc (Putco) is recalling certain Nitro-Lux LED Headlamp Bulb part numbers 700004 thru 709012.  The headlamp bulbs may cause excessive glare or brightness to oncoming drivers.
